chunks: The mountains move and fly away,
ai.seo_question: What happens to the mountains on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Al-Tur?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the displacement of mountains (tajawwal al-jibal) symbolizes the dissolution of the material world's stability and the removal of earthly attachments, preparing the soul for divine reckoning. This cosmic transformation underscores the absolute power of Allah to overturn established orders, a theme frequently linked with the resurrection of the dead and the final judgment in Surah At-Takwir.
